policy: Registries, language metadata, font repositories and character standards are separate source classes. A language record is not a font record.

languageRegistries.name: Glottolog
languageRegistries.vitality: not supplied by the base languoid table; keep unknown unless a separately sourced status field exists

languageRegistries.name: Google Fonts language data
languageRegistries.vitality: historical flag may be used only for the exact language record

languageRegistries.name: Unicode CLDR
languageRegistries.format: CLDR common/main XML; main and optional auxiliary UnicodeSet exemplars
languageRegistries.coverageLimit: Modern locale data (100+ languages); not a 7,000+ world-language census

fontRepositories.name: Google Fonts
fontRepositories.license: per-family; commonly OFL, but verify every family
fontRepositories.redistribution: allowed only under the family licence

fontRepositories.name: Fontsource
fontRepositories.redistribution: only source files with explicit redistribution rights

fontRepositories.name: SIL International
fontRepositories.format: family download pages and source archives
fontRepositories.redistribution: check SIL family licence and reserved font names

characterEvidence: font cmap coverage against a language exemplar character set
nonEvidence: same font in another weight, style, subset, file format or mirror
statusRules: historical or extinct status must be imported from a cited linguistic source; do not infer it from missing speakers or an old script
a language with no known font remains in the registry with a zero-font coverage record
